traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and technical requirements in docs/stories/003.0-DEV-FUNCTION-ANNOTATIONS.story.md are satisfied. The two core rules (require-story-annotation and require-req-annotation) share a common function-detection scope and exportPriority semantics via shared helpers, enforce their respective annotations on the same set of function-like constructs (FunctionDeclaration, FunctionExpression, MethodDefinition, TSDeclareFunction, TSMethodSignature), and explicitly exclude arrow functions by default. JSDoc and surrounding comments are parsed using a consistent strategy for both @story and @req, with robust error handling and fallbacks. TypeScript-specific syntax (TSDeclareFunction and TSMethodSignature) is fully supported and covered by tests. Error messages are clear and actionable, including function names and concrete remediation guidance. User documentation in user-docs/api-reference.md documents both rules, their options, and examples. Multiple Jest test suites explicitly tied to this story pass, exercising valid and invalid cases for all required behaviors. Therefore this story is fully implemented and passes.
